description: This file defines the CustomFieldRepository class, which interacts with the database to perform CRUD operations on custom fields in the application. It includes methods for finding, inserting, updating, and deleting custom field records.

classes.name: CustomFieldRepository
classes.description: Repository class providing database access methods for CustomField entities, including find, insert, update, and delete operations.

methods.name: findByParentId
methods.description: Finds custom fields by their parent type and optional parent ID.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Finds a custom field by its unique ID.

methods.name: deleteById
methods.description: Deletes a custom field record by its ID.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a new custom field record into the database.

methods.name: getBaseSelectQueryBuilder
methods.description: Provides a base QueryBuilder configured for selecting custom fields.

methods.name: updateById
methods.description: Updates a custom field record by its ID with new column values.
